positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
•	Legacy application support for in house software and web applications: bug fixes, new features, etc.
•	Developed front end for sister company web site (http://dnasolutionsusa.com) written in ASP Classic using Bootstrap and customizing theme from wrap bootstrap for a faster completion.
•	Developed intranet with an internal Employee Review System using ASP.NET MVC 4, Bootstrap, Javascript, JQuery, etc.
•	Managed and maintained all VMware virtual server infrastructure.
•	Implemented Citrix XenDesktop and XenApp virtualizing the end user environments.
•	Implemented Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plan including off-site replication at colocation facility
•	Successfully completed Microsoft Software Asset Management License Review and brought the company up to date on all licensing
•	Performed multiple server upgrades including Exchange Server 2013 upgrade
•	Developed and implemented IT processes, procedures, and documentation

positions.title: IT Supervisor

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
•	Provided IT support and managed help desk for over 200 users across two offices
•	Worked with vendors to implement point-to-point connection between offices
•	Arranged and cabled LAN access points for frequently evolving office environment
•	Configured, branded, and maintained offsite backup system for companies clients
•	Managed Active Directory Users and security rights via SBS 2011 servers

positions.title: Systems Development
positions.description:
•	Handled high-level help desk support escalations pertaining to FortiNet Firewalls, Kaseya Management Platform, Remote Backups, Microsoft Exchange Server, and Microsoft Server 2008
•	Performed quality assurance testing on new software, firmware, and firewall appliance hardware prior to rolling out to clients
•	Developed policies and procedures, technical guides, video walkthroughs and training for client and internal staff
•	Automated ticket creation and repetitive manual tasks by integrating Kaseya Management Platform with in-house ticketing system
•	Created branding for company Remote Backups, Antivirus, and Monitoring Agents

positions.title: IT Assistant
positions.description:
•	Created company intranet with content management system for end users (PHP / MySQL / HTML / CSS)
•	Maintained company web site
•	Handled all helpdesk support for 120 users
•	Provided support for The Agency Manager insurance software
